source.label: thm:regfh
source.quote: Suppose that the stationary $\varphi$-mixing process $(\theta_t,~ t \in \N)$ has an exponential mixing rate, so that there exists some $a, \gamma \in (0,\infty)$ such that $\varphi_m \leq a e^{-\gamma m}$ for all $m \in \N$. The regret (with respect to $\tilde{\nu}_n)$ of LinMix-UCB (finite horizon) played for $n \geq \left \lceil \frac{3 a \gamma \sqrt{\lambda}}{2 \sqrt{\lambda} \norm{\theta_t}_{\L_{\infty}}+\sqrt{2}} \right \rceil $ rounds satisfies ...

results.notes: Regret defined w.r.t. tilde nu_n = sup over policies of sum E<theta*, X_t>, i.e. against best fixed action for the stationary mean; classified as pseudo-regret. Multiplied the stated bound on R/||theta||_Linf by ||theta||_Linf (=S).

conditions: phi-mixing coefficients satisfy phi_m <= a_mix*exp(-gamma_mix*m) for all m
